test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A train leaves Hyderabad at 4:00 A.M. and reaches Vijayawada at 8:00 A.M. the same day. Another train leaves Vijayawada at 6:00 A.M. and reaches Hyderabad at 9:30 A.M the same day. At what time do the two trains cross each other?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total distance = LCM of 4 and 3.5 = 28 units. Speeds are 28 ÷ 4 = 7 units/hr and 28 ÷ 3.5 = 8 units/hr.

Train 1 travels from 4:00 A.M. to 6:00 A.M., covering 7 × 2 = 14 units.

Remaining distance = 28 − 14 = 14 units, and Relative speed = 7 + 8 = 15 units/hr.

Time to meet = 14 ÷ 15 hours = 56 minutes after 6:00 A.M., which is 6:56 A.M.

**∴ The correct answer is 6:56 A.M.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Train 1 timings: 4:00 A.M. to 8:00 A.M. (Time taken = 4 hours)

Train 2 timings: 6:00 A.M. to 9:30 A.M. (Time taken = 3.5 hours = 7/2 hours)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02c9f1ac8711cfad4952b53f3caca2162563ea28544df776b11ece016649c073.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Time to meet = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total distance between Hyderabad and Vijayawada be D = 28x km.

⇒ Speed of Train 1 = 28x ÷ 4 = 7x km/h

⇒ Speed of Train 2 = 28x ÷ (7/2) = 8x km/h

⇒ From 4:00 A.M. to 6:00 A.M. (2 hours), Train 1 covers distance = 2 × 7x = 14x km

⇒ Remaining distance at 6:00 A.M. = 28x − 14x = 14x km

⇒ As trains are moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = 7x + 8x = 15x km/h

⇒ Time taken to cross each other = Remaining distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time taken = 14x ÷ 15x = 14/15 hours

⇒ Converting into minutes = (14 ÷ 15) × 60 = 56 minutes

⇒ They cross each other 56 minutes after 6:00 A.M. = 6:56 A.M.

**∴ The correct answer is 6:56 A.M.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two bodies move towards each other (in opposite directions), their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂). When moving in the same direction, it is the difference (S₁ − S₂).

Time of Meeting

To calculate the exact time of meeting, always ensure both moving bodies start at the same reference time. The distance covered by the early starter must be subtracted from the total distance first.

Average Speed

When traveling the same distance at two different speeds S₁ and S₂, the Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).
